mapper.select: ( SELECT f.free_title AS title, f.free_created_dt AS created_at, f.free_view_cnt AS view_cnt, f.free_cmt_cnt AS cmt_cnt, f.free_like_cnt AS like_cnt, u.user_nickname, f.free_code AS post_code, 'FREE' AS post_type FROM tbl_free_post f JOIN tbl_user_info u ON f.user_code = u.user_code JOIN tbl_subscribe s ON f.user_code = s.subs_tg_user_code WHERE s.subs_user_code = #{userCode} AND f.free_isdeleted = 0 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT d.diet_title AS title, d.diet_upload_dt AS created_at, d.diet_view_cnt AS view_cnt, d.diet_cmt_cnt AS cmt_cnt, d.diet_like_cnt AS like_cnt, u.user_nickname, d.diet_code AS post_code, 'DIET' AS post_type FROM tbl_diet_post d JOIN tbl_user_info u ON d.user_code = u.user_code JOIN tbl_subscribe s ON d.user_code = s.subs_tg_user_code WHERE s.subs_user_code = #{userCode} AND d.diet_isdeleted = 0 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT s2.succ_title AS title, s2.succ_created_dt AS created_at, s2.succ_view_cnt AS view_cnt, s2.succ_cmt_cnt AS cmt_cnt, s2.succ_like_cnt AS like_cnt, u.user_nickname, s2.succ_code AS post_code, 'SUCCESS' AS post_type FROM tbl_success_post s2 JOIN tbl_user_info u ON s2.user_code = u.user_code JOIN tbl_subscribe s ON s2.user_code = s.subs_tg_user_code WHERE s.subs_user_code = #{userCode} AND s2.succ_isdeleted = 0 ) ORDER BY created_at DESC
